y-m-63-10.topic: Ọnụọgụ mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche nke ntụnyere (site n'iji local extrema nke ọrụ cubic)
y-m-63-10.goal: Ka a na-enye tebụl na ozi gbasara ịba ụba na ịda nke ọrụ cubic nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, gbanwee ikpe gị gbasara ọnụọgụ mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche nke f(x)=k, ma dee ọnụọgụ ahụ dabere n'oke nke k, gụnyere ụkpụrụ oke.
y-m-63-10.material:
Maka ọrụ f(x)=x³−6x²+9x na ọnụọgụ n'ezie k, chọta ọnụọgụ mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche nke ntụnyere f(x)=k (ọnụọgụ n'ezie dị iche x nke na-emezu ntụnyere) dabere n'ụkpụrụ nke k. (Gụọ 'x cubed mwepụ 6 x squared tinye 9x'.) Dị n'okpuru bụ f(x) na x ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
x | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
f(x) | 0 | 4 | 2 | 0 | 4

y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Chee echiche gbasara ntụnyere f(x)=2 maka k=2. N'tebụl, f(2)=2.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ole mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche ka ị chere f(x)=2 nwere? (f bụ ọrụ cubic na-aga n'ihu ma nwee mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche 3 kacha.)
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ebe f(0)=0<2<f(1)=4, enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'etiti 0 na 1; ebe f(2)=2, enwere mgbọrọgwụ na x=2; ma ebe f(3)=0<2<f(4)=4, enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'etiti 3 na 4. Enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche 3 kacha, ya mere enwere kpọmkwem 3 (n'ezie 2−√3, 2, 2+√3).
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nke a bụ ikpe nke kwụsịrị mgbe ọ lere naanị otu mgbọrọgwụ x=2 nke achọtara n'tebụl. Lee ma enwere oge ndị ọzọ ebe ụkpụrụ tebụl na-esi n'okpuru 2 gaa n'elu 2.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe nke chọtara oge niile dị n'tebụl ebe ụkpụrụ f(x) na-agafe 2 ma gụọ ebe mgbọrọgwụ dị.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nke a bụ ikpe nke gbakwunyere naanị otu na mgbọrọgwụ e lelere n'tebụl. Lelee ma ị chọtara oge niile ebe ụkpụrụ na-agafe 2.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Enweghị ike ịmata ya site na tebụl naanị.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Nke a bụ ikpe nke lere ya dị ka ihe na-enweghị ike ikwu ihe ọ bụla gbasara x nke na-adịghị n'tebụl. Ị nwere ike iji ihe onwunwe na mgbe ọrụ na-aga n'ihu na-agafe ụkpụrụ, enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'etiti.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Chee echiche gbasara f(x)=5 maka k=5. F(x) niile dị n'tebụl dị opekata mpe 4. Mgbe anyị gbasaara tebụl, f(5)=20 na f(−1)=−16. Ọzọkwa f′(x)=3(x−1)(x−3), ya mere f na-abawanye maka x<1, na-ada maka 1<x<3, ma na-abawanye maka x>3.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ole mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche ka f(x)=5 nwere?
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Maka x<1, f na-abawanye mana ọ na-eru naanị f(1)=4 ma ọ naghị eru 5; maka 1<x<3 ọ na-ada site na 4 ruo 0; ma maka x>3 ọ na-abawanye site na 0, ma ebe f(4)=4<5<f(5)=20, ọ na-agafe 5 otu ugboro n'etiti 4 na 5. Enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche 1.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Nke a bụ echiche nke kpebiri site n'ilele naanị ụkpụrụ n'ime oke tebụl. Lee otu f si agbanwe n'èzí tebụl.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Nke a bụ echiche nke bubatara ọnụọgụ maka k=2 dị ka ọ dị. Mgbe k na-agbanwe, ebe ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n'ala na-ezute eserese na-agbanwekwa.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Nke a bụ echiche nke bubatara ọnụọgụ maka ọnọdụ ịmetụ na local extremum. Lelee ma f(x)=5 hà nhata extreme value.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Nke a bụ ikpe nke lere n'oge ọ bụla nke ịba ụba na ịda ma ụkpụrụ f na-agafe 5 ma gụọ ebe mgbọrọgwụ dị.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Local maximum bụ f(1)=4 ma local minimum bụ f(3)=0. Kwaga ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n'ala y=k n'elu na n'ala n'eserese ma gụọ ọnụọgụ isi ntụ ebe ọ na-ezute eserese.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu oke k na-enye kpọmkwem mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche 3?
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Ọ bụrụ na k dị n'etiti 0 na 4, ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n'ala na-ezute eserese n'isi ntụ atọ, ya mere enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche 3. Ọ bụrụ na k=0 ma ọ bụ k=4, ọ na-emetụ n'otu isi ntụ, ya mere enwere mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie dị iche 2 (k=0: 0, 3 / k=4: 1, 4), ma ọ bụrụ na k<0 ma ọ bụ k>4, enwere 1.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Nke a bụ ikpe nke hapụrụ na na k=0 na k=4 isi ntụ ịmetụ na-adabara ma ọnụọgụ mgbọrọgwụ dị iche na-ebelata.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe nke gwakọtara nhazi x 1, 3 nke isi ntụ local extremum na extreme values 4, 0.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Nke a bụ ikpe nke gụrụ na ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n'ala ga-adị n'etiti ụkpụrụ local minimum na ụkpụrụ local maximum iji zute n'isi ntụ atọ.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Nke a bụ ikpe nke gụrụ oke ebe enwere mgbọrọgwụ 1 dị ka oke ebe enwere 3.

y-m-63-09.title: Ọ bụrụ local maximum, ọ bụkwa maximum interval?
y-m-63-09.topic: Local extrema na maximum n’ime closed interval.
y-m-63-09.goal: Hazie mgbe local maximum hà maximum closed interval na mgbe ọ bụghị, mepụta interval counterexample, depụta ihe a ga-atụnyere iji chọta maximum.
y-m-63-09.material:
Tụlee f(x)=x³−3x. (Gụọ x cubed wepụ 3x.) Derivative f′(x)=3(x+1)(x−1). Uru integer x dị n’okpuru:
x | −2 | −1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
f(x) | −2 | 2 | 0 | −2 | 2 | 18
Minji kwuru, “Ọ bụrụ na e nwere local maximum n’ime closed interval, uru local maximum ahụ bụ maximum f na interval ahụ.”
y-m-63-09.thinking.2: Hazie candidates maximum niile n’enweghị nke furu efu.

y-m-63-09.s.s1.o.a: Maximum bụ 2, ọ na-apụta naanị x=−1, ebe local maximum dị.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.a: Mkpebi a lere local maximum naanị, o tụnyereghị uru na nsọtụ interval.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe nke gụrụ ụkpụrụ kacha nta dị ka kacha elu n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ma ọ bụ lere naanị local minimum.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.o.c: Kacha elu bụ 2, a na-ewerekwa ya na x=−1 na x=2.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ikpe nke chịkọtara ma tụnyere isi ntụ ndị bụ local extrema na ụkpụrụ dị na njedebe oge.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị kacha elu. Local maximum enweghị ike ịbụ kacha elu nke oge.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ echiche nke hapụrụ ọnọdụ ebe local maximum nwere ike ịhà nhata kacha elu nke oge. Tụnyere ya na ụkpụrụ dị na njedebe oge a.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.explain: Enwere local maximum na x=−1 nwere f(−1)=2, ma na njedebe f(−2)=−2 na f(2)=2. Ya mere kacha elu bụ 2, a na-ewerekwa ya na x=−1 na x=2. N'oge a, nkwupụta Minji yiri ka ọ na-adị mma.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.prompt: Anyị gbasaara oge ka ọ bụrụ [−2, 3], ma f(3)=18. Gịnị na-eme nkwupụta Minji?

y-m-63-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye ụkpụrụ local maximum na ụkpụrụ dị na njedebe ọhụrụ n'akụkụ ibe ha ma tụnyere nke buru ibu.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.a: Ọ naghị adị mma. Ụkpụrụ 18 na njedebe x=3 buru ibu karịa 2.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.a: Nke a bụ ikpe nke tụnyere ọbụna ụkpụrụ dị na njedebe e gụnyere ọhụrụ ka oge gbasaa.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.b: Ọ ka na-adị mma. Local maximum 2 ka dị n'oge ahụ.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe nke lere naanị na local maximum dị n'oge ahụ ma tụnyereghị ma enwere ụkpụrụ buru ibu karịa.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.c: Ọ naghị adị mma. Isi ntụ nke bụ local maximum pụọ ka oge gbanwere.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.c: Nke a bụ ikpe nke hapụrụ na a na-ekpebi local maximum site n'udi dị nso na x=−1, ya mere ọ na-anọgide ọbụna ma njedebe oge gbanwere.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee oge ọ na-aghọ ọrụ dị iche, ya mere ị pụghị ịtụnyere.

y-m-63-04.title: Anyị ọ̀ nwere ike ịchọta f(3) site n'ọnọdụ a naanị?
y-m-63-04.topic: Ịkpebi polynomial function site n'nkọwa nke derivative na ọnọdụ oke
y-m-63-04.goal: Site n'ọnọdụ oke e nyere, hazie ihe a pụrụ ịmara banyere function ahụ (f(2), f′(2)), ma kpee ikpe ozi ọzọ chọrọ ka e kpebie f(3).
y-m-63-04.material:
f bụ polynomial function, e nyekwara ọnọdụ oke a.
Uru oke nke f(x)/(x−2) ka x na-abịaru 2 nso bụ 3.
(Nke a pụtara na uru oke nke 'f(x) kewara site na x wepụ 2' bụ 3.) Ka anyị lee ma a pụrụ ịchọta uru f(3).

y-m-63-04.thinking.1: Kpee ikpe ma ozi ọzọ zuru ezu
y-m-63-04.thinking.2: Gosi site n'ihe atụ na ozi ahụ ezughị
y-m-63-04.prereq.1: Eziokwu na polynomial functions na-aga n'ihu, na nkọwa nke derivative (oke nke difference quotient)
y-m-63-04.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka a pụrụ ikwu banyere uru f(2) n'okpuru ọnọdụ a?
y-m-63-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nwalee site n'ọnụọgụ ihe na-eme quotient ma ọ bụrụ na numerator na-abịaru ọnụọgụ na-abụghị zero nso ka denominator na-abịaru 0 nso.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa n'ikpe ebe numerator na-abịaru 0 nso na ikpe ebe ọ na-abịaghị, ma tụnyere ka quotient si agagharị.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ echiche gụrụ uru oke 3 nke quotient dịka f(2). 3 bụ oke nke quotient nke f(x) kewara site na x−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.o.b: f(2) nwere ike ịbụ ọnụọgụ ọ bụla.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ echiche hapụrụ na ọ bụrụ na numerator na-abịaru ọnụọgụ na-abụghị zero nso ka denominator na-abịaru 0 nso, quotient na-eto n'enweghị oke.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ echiche tụlere ka numerator ga-esi na-agagharị ka quotient na-abịaru ọnụọgụ nwere njedebe nso mgbe denominator na-aga 0.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ịmara uru f(2) ma enwere ike ịmara naanị f′(2).
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ echiche enweghị ike ijikọ numerator f(x)−f(2) nke difference quotient na f(x) n'ọnọdụ a.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.explain: Denominator x−2 na-abịaru 0 nso, ya mere ka quotient na-abịaru 3 nso numerator f(x) ga-abịarukwa 0 nso. Polynomial function na-aga n'ihu, ya mere f(2)=0, mgbe ahụ f(x)/(x−2)=(f(x)−f(2))/(x−2), ya mere anyị nwekwara ike ịmara na f′(2)=3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.prompt: Ewezuga f(2)=0 na f′(2)=3, kedu ozi agbakwunyere ga-ekpebi uru f(3) dịka otu? Họrọ ihe niile zuru ezu.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.hint.0: Gụọ ọnụọgụ coefficients ole ka a ga-achọta maka linear, quadratic, na cubic functions, ma tụnyere ya na ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ ị nwere ugbu a.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.hint.1: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, nwalee ma ị nwere ike ime functions abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.a: Nke a bụ mkpebi nke lelebeghị na ịmara naanị degree anaghị ekpebi coefficients nke quadratic function dịka otu.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.b: Nke a bụ mkpebi jiri eziokwu na linear function zuru ezu kpebiri site na f(2)=0 na slope f′(2)=3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.c: f bụ cubic function ma f(0)=−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.c: Nke a bụ mkpebi hụrụ ịgbakwunye otu uru dịka ọ na-ekpebi ya. Cubic function nwere ọtụtụ coefficients, ya mere otu uru ka na-ahapụ otu coefficient.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.d: f bụ cubic function ma f(1)=−3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.d: Nke a bụ mkpebi hụrụ function dịka e kpebiri ya n'ihi na ọ na-eme ka ọ kwekọọ n'uru nke otu linear function. Functions ndị ọzọ nwere ike inwe otu uru ahụ.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.e: f bụ quadratic function ma f(0)=−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.e: Nke a bụ mkpebi gbakwunyere degree na otu uru function ma mee ka ọnụọgụ coefficients a ga-achọta kwekọọ n'ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.explain: f(2)=0 na f′(2)=3 bụ ọnọdụ abụọ ugbu a. Linear function nwere coefficients abụọ, ya mere e kpebiri ya dịka f(x)=3(x−2), f(3)=3. Ọ bụrụ na e nyere quadratic function na f(0)=−2 ọnụ, e kpebiri ya dịka f(x)=(x−2)(x+1), f(3)=4. Eziokwu nke ịbụ quadratic naanị anaghị ekpebi f(3)=p+3 (p bụ coefficient nke x²), ịgbakwunye otu uru n'cubic function na-ahapụkwa otu coefficient.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.prompt: Anyị chọrọ igosi na ịgbakwunye naanị 'f bụ quadratic function' ezughị. Site na f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a, b, c bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, a≠0), mee functions 2 na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị gara aga (f(2)=0, f′(2)=3) ma nwee f(3) dị iche.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ họrọ a, ma dee ka a na-ekpebi b na c site n'ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.hint.1: Mee functions abụọ nwere a dị iche, mgbe ahụ gbakọọ f(3) nke ọ bụla ma tụnyere.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.ok.c1: a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-abụghị zero, b na c bụkwa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Ebe ọ bụ quadratic, a ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-abụghị zero, b na c ga-abụkwa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c2: f(2), nke a chọtara site n'itinye x=2, abụghị 0.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.ok.c3: f(x)/(x−2) na-abịaru 3 nso ka x na-abịaru 2 nso.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c3: f(x)/(x−2) anaghị abịaru 3 nso ka x na-abịaru 2 nso. Lee nkwupụta quotient hà mgbe f(2)=0, na uru nkwupụta ahụ mgbe ị tinye 2.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na anyị dee f(x)=(x−2)(px+q), mgbe ahụ f′(2)=2p+q=3, ya mere q=3−2p, f(3)=p+3. Ọ bụrụ na p agbanwe, f(3) na-agbanwekwa. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na f(x)=x²−x−2, mgbe ahụ f(3)=4, ọ bụrụkwa na f(x)=2x²−5x+2, mgbe ahụ f(3)=5.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.prompt: N'otu ahịrịokwu ma ọ bụ abụọ, dee ka functions abụọ ị mere si egosi na 'ozi na ọ bụ quadratic naanị anaghị ekpebi f(3)'.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ahịrịokwu na-elele ma f(2) na f′(2) bụ otu maka functions abụọ ị mere.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Dee f(3) nke functions abụọ ahụ n'akụkụ ibe ha ma tụnyere ma ha bụ otu.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ị dere eziokwu abụọ ahụ: functions abụọ ahụ na-emezu otu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma f(3) ha dị iche?
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ị gara n'ihu kwuo 'ya mere ozi ọzọ dị mkpa'?
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.0: x²−x−2 na 2x²−5x+2 abụọ na-emezu f(2)=0 na f′(2)=3, ma f(3) ha dị iche, 4 na 5. Ya mere ọnọdụ nke ịbụ quadratic naanị anaghị ekpebi f(3), ozi ọzọ dịkwa mkpa.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.1: Quadratic functions abụọ na-emezu otu ọnọdụ niile, ma f(3) pụtara dịka uru dị iche. A naghị ekpebi azịza dịka otu n'okpuru otu ọnọdụ, ya mere ozi a ezughị.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.2: Ọbụlagodi na a dị iche, a nwere ike ime ka f(2)=0 na f'(2)=3 bụrụ otu, f(3)=a+3 kwa, ya mere f(3) dị iche maka a ọ bụla. Ya mere enweghị ike ịmara f(3) site n'ozi na ọ bụ quadratic naanị.

y-m-63-05.title: Ebe kedu ka differentiation Hajun si gaa na-ezighị ezi?
y-m-63-05.topic: Ịchọta derivative nke polynomial functions: ilele njehie n'ngwọta site n'iji product rule
y-m-63-05.goal: N'ngwọta na-achọta derivative nke function e nyere dịka ngwaahịa, chọta ahịrị nwere njehie, kọwaa na inwe otu uru n'otu ebe anaghị ekwe nkwa na ngwọta ahụ ziri ezi, ma dee ya ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
y-m-63-05.material:
Hajun chọtara derivative f′(x) nke f(x)=(x²+1)(x³−x) dịka ndị a. (A na-agụ x² dịka 'x squared' ma a na-agụ x³ dịka 'x cubed'.)
Ahịrị ndị ahụ bụ ahịrị nke 1, nke 2, nke 3, na nke 4 site n'elu.

y-m-63-05.prereq.1: Derivative nke xⁿ na ịchọta derivative nke nchikota na ọdịiche nke polynomials
y-m-63-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ n'ngwọta Hajun ebe e jiri iwu n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dee n'okwu iwu kedu ahịrị ọ bụla jiri.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.1: Dee iwu nke ahịrị ọ bụla n'okwu, tinye iwu ahụ n'ngwaahịa dị mfe dịka x·x, gbasaa ya ma chọta derivative ya ozugbo, ma tụnyere nsonaazụ ahụ.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.line.0: Ka g(x)=x²+1 na h(x)=x³−x. Mgbe ahụ f(x)=g(x)h(x).
y-m-63-05.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị nke 3 na-ezighị ezi. Derivative nke ngwaahịa nke functions abụọ abụghị g′(x)h′(x) kama ọ bụ g′(x)h(x)+g(x)h′(x). N'ihe atụ dị mfe x·x, ngwaahịa nke derivatives bụ 1·1=1, ma derivative nke x² bụ 2x. Ahịrị 1 na 2 ziri ezi, ahịrị nke 4 na-agbakọkwa naanị nsonaazụ nke ahịrị nke 3 dịka ọ dị.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.prompt: Hajun kwuru, "M nwetakwara 4 maka f′(1) mgbe m chọtara derivative nke nkwupụta x⁵−x, nke m nwetara site n'ịgbasa ngwaahịa ahụ buru ụzọ. Nsonaazụ m nyekwara 4, ya mere ngwọta m ziri ezi!" Kedu mkpebi kwesịrị ekwesị maka nkwupụta a?
y-m-63-05.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu uru ọzọ ewezuga x=1, ma gbakọọ maka ya nsonaazụ Hajun na nsonaazụ nke ịchọta derivative mgbe ịgbasachara.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri eziokwu na ọ bụrụ na nkwupụta abụọ bụ otu, ha ga-abụ otu na x ọ bụla.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.a: x=1 bụ obere ọnụọgụ, ya mere ọ bụghị nnwale n'ezie. Ị kwesịrị iji ọnụọgụ buru ibu dịka 100 tụnyere.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.a: Nke a bụ mkpebi hụrụ nha nke ebe e nwalere dịka nsogbu. Ihe dị mkpa bụ ilele n'ebe dị iche.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.b: Ịbụ otu n'otu ebe nwere ike ịbụ ihe dakọtara. Ị kwesịrị ilelekwa n'x ndị ọzọ.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.b: Nke a bụ mkpebi na-adọtaghị nkwubi okwu site n'nkwekọrịta n'otu ebe ma na-anwa ịhọrọ ebe ndị ọzọ ka e nwalee.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.c: Ọ ziri ezi. Ụzọ abụọ ahụ nyere otu uru, ya mere ngwọta ahụ ziri ezi.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.c: Nke a bụ mkpebi hụrụ inwe otu uru n'otu ebe dịka ihe akaebe na nkwupụta ndị ahụ bụ otu.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.d: Ọ na-ezighị ezi. O jighị product rule, ya mere uru ndị ahụ enweghị ike ịbụ otu.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.d: Nke a bụ mkpebi gwakọtara ụzọ ịbụ nke na-ezighị ezi na uru ndị ahụ ịbụ otu n'otu ebe. Ụzọ na-ezighị ezi nwekwara ike inye otu uru n'ihi ohere.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.explain: Na x=1, abụọ bụ 4 dịka o siri dakọta. Na x=2, nkwupụta Hajun na-enye 6·8−4=44 ma nkwupụta 5x⁴−1 nke e nwetara site n'ịchọta derivative mgbe ịgbasachara na-enye 79, ya mere ha dị iche. Nkwekọrịta n'otu ebe abụghị ihe akaebe na nkwupụta ndị ahụ bụ otu.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.prompt: Dee ahịrị nke 3 nke Hajun ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi iji chọta f′(x) ziri ezi, ma gwa Hajun n'otu ahịrịokwu ihe na-ezighị ezi.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.hint.0: Chọta derivative nke nkwupụta e nwetara site n'ịgbasa ngwaahịa ahụ.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.hint.1: Dee udi nke product rule n'onwe gị, mgbe ahụ tụnyere ma nsonaazụ nke ụzọ abụọ ahụ bụ otu.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị tụnyere f′(x) ị dere na nkwupụta Hajun na x=2 ma lelee na ha dị iche?
y-m-63-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru ihe kpatara na ọ na-ezighị ezi site n'iwu kedu ziri ezi, ọ bụghị naanị 'iwu dị iche'?
y-m-63-05.s.s3.model.0: Site n'product rule, f′(x)=g′h+gh′=2x(x³−x)+(x²+1)(3x²−1)=5x⁴−1. Ị ga-eji product rule, ọ bụghị ịmịkọrịta derivatives.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbasaa buru ụzọ, f(x)=x⁵−x, ya mere f′(x)=5x⁴−1. Hajun mịkọrịtara derivatives dị iche naanị, ma derivative nke ngwaahịa anaghị arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ ahụ.

y-m-63-07.title: Enwere tangent line naanị otu gafee isi P?
y-m-63-07.topic: Nhata tangent line: tangent e sere site n’isi dị n’èzí curve.
y-m-63-07.goal: N’ịchọta tangent si n’isi na-adịghị na curve, kewaa isi tangent na isi ahịrị na-agafe, gosi ozugbo na ọtụtụ tangent nwere ike ịdị.
y-m-63-07.material:
Curve bụ y=x², isi P(1,−3). (Gụọ y bụ x squared.) Mgbe x=1, y curve bụ 1, ya mere P adịghị na curve. Nara dozie ya otu a:
“Ọ bụrụ f(x)=x², f′(x)=2x na f′(1)=2. Ya mere tangent line slope 2 gafere P(1,−3) bụ y−(−3)=2(x−1), ya bụ y=2x−5.”
Tangent line bụ ahịrị na-agafe isi dị na curve (isi tangent), slope ya bụ derivative n’isi ahụ.

y-m-63-01.title: Oke e chere site na tebụl: ole ka anyị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi?
y-m-63-01.topic: Oke nke ọrụ: oke aka ekpe na oke aka nri, na ọdịiche dị n'etiti uru oke na uru ọrụ
y-m-63-01.goal: Oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe data nke tebụl, hazie ikpe gị na ogo ntụkwasị obi banyere oke, ma kọwaa na uru oke bụ ajụjụ dị iche na uru ọrụ na x=2.
y-m-63-01.material: A kọwapụtara ọrụ f dị ka f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) mgbe x≠2. (Gụọ ya dị ka 'x squared minus 4' e kewara site na 'x minus 2'.) Uru na x=2 anaghị enye na mbụ. A na-ekpughe uru f(x) e chọtara site na kalkuleta site n'izipu x nso na 2 nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ. Ebe a 'uru oke' bụ uru f(x) na-abịaru mgbe x dị iche na 2 ma na-abịaru nso na 2 n'enweghị ọgwụgwụ.

y-m-63-02.title: Ọ bụrụ na oke nke ngụkọta dị, oke nke ọrụ ọ bụla dịkwa?
y-m-63-02.topic: Àgwà nke oke ọrụ: oke nke ngụkọta na ihe atụ megidere
y-m-63-02.goal: Gbuo nkwupụta 'ọ bụrụ na oke nke ngụkọta dị, oke nke ọrụ ọ bụla dị' site n'ihe atụ megidere, ma hazie n'ntụziaka ole iwu ngụkọta nke oke na-adị.
y-m-63-02.material: Gyuri kwuru, "Ọ bụrụ na oke nke f(x)+g(x) dị ka x na-abịaru 0, mgbe ahụ oke nke f(x) na oke nke g(x) nke ọ bụla dịkwa." Ebe a f na g bụ ọrụ akọwapụtara n'akụkụ x=0 (x≠0). 'Oke dị' pụtara na ọ na-abịaru otu ọnụọgụ n'ezie, ma ikpe ebe ọ na-ata ahụhụ n'enweghị ókè ma ọ bụ na-ebelata n'enweghị ókè, ma ọ bụ ebe aka ekpe na aka nri dị iche, ka a na-akpọ 'oke adịghị'. A na-agụ 1/x dị ka 'otu n'elu x'.

y-m-63-02.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ echiche nke anaghị anabata nkwupụta ahụ naanị kama na-anwa ichọta ma nwalee ozugbo ikpe ebe ịkagbu na-eme n'ngụkọta.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ikwu. Anyị enweghị ike idochi 0, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ikpe oke.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ echiche nke hapụrụ ikpe n'ihi na enweghị ike idochi x=0. Enwere ụzọ ilele otú uru na-abịaru.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.explain: Iji nwalee ma nkwupụta ahụ bụ eziokwu 'mgbe niile', ụzọ kacha nso bụ ịchọ ihe atụ ebe oke nke ngụkọta dị ma nke ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị.
y-m-63-02.s.s2.prompt: Site na f(x)=a/x na g(x)=b/x+c (x≠0, ma a, b, c bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −9 ruo 9), mee ihe atụ 2 dị iche ebe nkwupụta Gyuri na-ezighị ezi. Oke nke f(x)+g(x) ga-adịrị ma oke nke f agaghị adị.

y-m-63-02.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ uru na-abụghị efu maka a, ma mgbe ahụ họrọ b ka akụkụ nke ngụkọta nwere x n'ihe nkesa na-apụ.

y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.a: Ọ bụrụ na oke nke f+g dị, oke nke f na g nke ọ bụla dịkwa.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.r.a: Nke a bụ ikpe nke were ntụziaka na-alaghachi site n'oke nke ngụkọta gaa oke nke akụkụ ọ bụla dị ka eziokwu. Chetakwa ihe atụ megidere site n'nzọụkwụ gara aga.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.b: Ọ bụrụ na oke nke f na g abụọ dị, oke nke f+g dịkwa.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe nke gụrụ ntụziaka nke iwu ngụkọta nke oke n'ụzọ ziri ezi (ọ bụrụ na nke ọ bụla dị, ngụkọta dị).
y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị oke nke f ma ọ bụghị oke nke g dị, oke nke f+g adịghịkwa.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.r.c: Nke a bụ ikpe na ọ bụrụ na nke ọ bụla enweghị oke, ngụkọta enwekwaghị. Tụnyere ya na ihe atụ gara aga ebe ị mere ụzọ na-akagbu ibe ha.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na oke nke f dị ma nke g adịghị, oke nke f+g adịghị.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.r.d: Nke a bụ ikpe nke jiri g=(f+g)−f chee na ịkagbu enweghị ike ime mgbe naanị otu nwere oke.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.explain: b bụ iwu ngụkọta nke oke. d na-adị n'ihi na ọ bụrụ na anyị were na oke nke f+g dị, mgbe ahụ oke nke g=(f+g)−f ga-adịrịkwa, nke na-enye mmegide. Maka a na c, f=1/x na g=−1/x site n'nzọụkwụ gara aga bụ ihe atụ megidere.

y-m-63-03.title: Ụzọ (a, b) ole dị n'ozuzu nke na-agbajighị na x=1?
y-m-63-03.topic: Ịga n'ihu nke functions: undetermined coefficients nke piecewise-defined functions
y-m-63-03.goal: Gosi site n'iwu ha n'onwe gị na e nwere ọtụtụ ụzọ constants nke na-eme ka piecewe-defined function gaa n'ihu na x=1, ma kpee ikpe ihe na-agbanwe mgbe a gbakwunyere ọnọdụ differentiability.
y-m-63-03.material:
Maka constants a na b, kọwaa function f dịka a na-eso.
Maka x<1, f(x)=x²+ax
Maka x≥1, f(x)=3x+b
(A na-agụ x² dịka 'x squared'.) Ka anyị chọta (a, b) nke na-eme ka function a gaa n'ihu na x=1.

y-m-63-03.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ echiche hụrụ naanị na e kọwapụtara uru function dịka ọnọdụ nke ịga n'ihu. Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti uru oke na uru function na-efu.
y-m-63-03.s.s1.o.b: Left-hand limit na right-hand limit bụ otu, uru ahụ hà f(1).
y-m-63-03.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ echiche sụgharịrị nkọwa nke ịga n'ihu kpọmkwem dịka nkwekọrịta nke oke site n'akụkụ abụọ na uru function.
y-m-63-03.s.s1.o.c: Uru derivative nke nkwupụta abụọ ahụ na x=1 ga-ahà.
y-m-63-03.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ echiche gwakọtara ọnọdụ nke differentiability na ọnọdụ nke ịga n'ihu.
y-m-63-03.s.s1.o.d: Nkwupụta maka x<1 na nkwupụta maka x≥1 ga-abụ otu nkwupụta.
y-m-63-03.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ echiche hụrụ na nkwupụta abụọ ahụ chọrọ ịbụ otu ka o gaa n'ihu. Ọbụlagodi na nkwupụta dị iche, ha nwere ike ijikọta ma ọ bụrụ na ha zutere n'otu uru.
y-m-63-03.s.s1.o.e: Uru 1+a na 3+b, ndị a nwetara site n'itinye x=1 n'nkwupụta abụọ ahụ, hà.

y-m-63-06.title: Ọ bụrụ na ọ continuous, slope ọ na-abụ otu uru kwa?
y-m-63-06.topic: Mmekọrịta continuity na differentiability (ịgụ tebụl difference quotient).
y-m-63-06.goal: Jiri tebụl dị nso x=1 dịka ihe akaebe, kpebie nkwupụta mmekọrịta continuity/differentiability, dee mmekọrịta abụọ ahụ kpọmkwem, gụnye ntụziaka ya.
y-m-63-06.material:
Lelee f(x)=|x−1| na g(x)=(x−1)² na x=1. (|x−1| bụ absolute value nke x wepụ 1; (x−1)² bụ x wepụ 1 squared.) f(1)=0, g(1)=0. h abụghị 0, derivative na x=1 bụ uru {f(1+h)−f(1)}/h na-abịaru ka h na-abịaru 0. Jihye kwuru, “Ọ bụrụ function continuous na x=1, function ahụ differentiable na x=1.”
h | −0.1 | −0.01 | 0.01 | 0.1
f(1+h) | 0.1 | 0.01 | 0.01 | 0.1
{f(1+h)−f(1)}/h | −1 | −1 | 1 | 1
g(1+h) | 0.01 | 0.0001 | 0.0001 | 0.01
{g(1+h)−g(1)}/h | −0.1 | −0.01 | 0.01 | 0.1
y-m-63-06.thinking.0: Ịgụ usoro difference quotient na tebụl.
y-m-63-06.thinking.2: Kọwaa mmekọrịta echiche abụọ, gụnye ntụziaka ya.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.prompt: Gụọ tebụl, họrọ nkọwa ziri ezi niile.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kewaa ahịrị tebụl nke ọ bụla ma ọ bụ data continuity ka ọ bụ derivative.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dee iche uru difference quotient function ọ bụla na-abịaru mgbe h negative na mgbe h positive.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.o.a: f(1+h) na-abịaru 0, ya mere f yiri continuous na x=1.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.r.a: Mkpebi a gụrụ continuity site n’usoro uru function.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.o.b: Nkezi difference quotient f, −1 na 1, bụ 0, ya mere derivative f na x=1 bụ 0.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.r.b: Echiche a jikọtara uru aka ekpe/aka nri dị iche site na average. Derivative dị naanị ma uru abịakọta n’otu uru.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.o.c: Difference quotient f dị iche, −1 na 1, ya mere f abụghị continuous na x=1.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.r.c: Echiche a gụrụ quotient dị iche dịka enweghị continuity. Continuity a na-ahụ site n’uru f(1+h).
y-m-63-06.s.s1.o.d: Difference quotient g na-abịaru 0 site n’akụkụ abụọ, ya mere derivative g yiri 0.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.r.d: Mkpebi a gụrụ quotient aka ekpe na aka nri jikọtara n’otu nọmba dịka ihe akaebe derivative.
y-m-63-06.s.s1.explain: f(1+h) na-abịaru 0 dịka 0.1,0.01, ya mere ọ yiri continuous; difference quotient g na-abịaru 0 n’akụkụ abụọ, ya mere derivative yiri 0. Difference quotient f dị iche: −1 maka h<0, 1 maka h>0.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.prompt: Banyere nkwupụta Jihye “ọ bụrụ continuous, differentiable,” kedu mkpebi dabara na tebụl?
y-m-63-06.s.s2.hint.0: N’ime tebụl f, chọta ahịrị ihe akaebe continuity na derivative na-emegide ibe ha.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri |h|/h lelee ma uru anọ tebụl ahụ bụ otu ụdị maka h niile.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.o.a: Eziokwu. f na g continuous na x=1, ya mere ọ na-ejide.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.r.a: Mkpebi a lelere naanị ihe atụ continuous abụọ, ọ leghị ma ha differentiable.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.o.b: Amaghị. E nwere uru h anọ naanị, anyị kwesịrị iji okwu nyochakwuo.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.r.b: Mkpebi a maara na tebụl nwere isi ole na ole, gbalịa iji okwu nyochaa.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.o.c: Ụgha. f continuous, ma quotient dị iche dabere akara h.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.r.c: Mkpebi a nyere continuous function dịka counterexample, slope aka ekpe na aka nri dị iche.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.o.d: Ụgha. g continuous, derivative ya bụ 0, ya mere ọ bụghị differentiable.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.r.d: Mkpebi a gwakọtara derivative ịbụ 0 na derivative adịghị.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.explain: f continuous na x=1, ma quotient bụ −1 mgbe h<0, 1 mgbe h>0, ya mere derivative abụghị otu uru. Ya mere “continuous ⇒ differentiable” nwere counterexample, ọ bụghị eziokwu. Site na formula f(1+h)−f(1)=|h|, quotient bụ 1 mgbe niile maka h>0, −1 maka h<0.
y-m-63-06.s.s2.acc.0: Tebụl nwere uru h anọ naanị, ya mere mkpebi a kpachara anya. Ebe f(1+h)−f(1)=|h|, lelee formula quotient bụ 1 mgbe h>0, −1 mgbe h<0, ị ga-akwado na ọ bụ ụgha.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.prompt: Hazie mmekọrịta continuity/differentiability, gụnye ntụziaka ya, n’ahịrịokwu 1–2 kpọmkwem, nye ihe atụ.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.hint.0: Lelee tebụl ọzọ function continuous ma derivative ya edozighị.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.hint.1: Dee ahịrịokwu abụọ iche: “Ọ bụrụ differentiable, mgbe ahụ …” na “Ọ bụrụ continuous, mgbe ahụ …”.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.placeholder: Ihe atụ: Ọ bụrụ differentiable, …; ọbụna ma continuous, …
y-m-63-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị kewara “differentiable na-egosi continuous” na “continuous na-egosi differentiable” dịka nkwupụta dị iche?
y-m-63-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: N’ihe atụ, i kwuru isi ebe ọ continuous na ebe slope na-edozighị?
y-m-63-06.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ differentiable, ọ na-adị continuous mgbe niile; ma continuous apụtaghị differentiable. Dịka |x−1| continuous na x=1 ma ọ bụghị differentiable, n’ihi na slope aka ekpe/aka nri dị iche.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.model.1: Function differentiable bụ continuous. Ma ọ bụghị function continuous niile differentiable. N’isi graph nwere nkọ, dịka x=0 maka |x|, ọ continuous ma derivative adịghị.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.model.2: Ọ bụrụ differentiable, ọ continuous. Ma ọbụna continuous, o nwere ike ghara differentiable. Dịka y=|x−1| nwere isi nkọ x=1.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.model.3: Differentiable ⇒ continuous bụ eziokwu; continuous ⇒ differentiable bụ ụgha. Ihe atụ: absolute value function.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.modelNote.3: Azịza e dere site na akara.
y-m-63-06.s.s3.model.4: Ọ bụrụ differentiable, continuous. Ma ọbụna continuous, o nwere ike ghara differentiable. Dịka |x−1|.

y-m-63-08.title: Olee otu a ga-esi chọpụta velocity n’otu instant?
y-m-63-08.topic: Site na average rate of change gaa instantaneous rate: ihe velocity pụtara.
y-m-63-08.goal: Lelee echiche instantaneous velocity site na tebụl average velocity n’interval na-adị nta nta; degharịa ya n’okwu nwa middle school ga-aghọta, n’enweghị limit notation.
y-m-63-08.material:
Ka anya njem n’ime t sekọnd bụrụ s(t)=2t²+t (mita). (Gụọ 2 t squared tinyere t.) Na t=2, s(2)=10 mita. Anyị gbakọrọ average velocity {s(2+h)−s(2)}/h n’interval [2,2+h] sekọnd malite sekọnd 2.
h (sekọnd) | 1 | 0.5 | 0.1 | 0.01
Average velocity (m/s) | 11 | 10 | 9.2 | 9.02
Minsu chọrọ ikwu kpọmkwem velocity n’instant sekọnd 2. (2 2)
y-m-63-08.thinking.1: Chọta ahịrị echiche na-ezighị ezi n’kọwa.
y-m-63-08.thinking.2: Degharịa echiche ka ọ dabara onye a na-agwa.

y-m-63-08.s.s1.prompt: Minsu chọrọ ikwu “velocity na sekọnd 2” dịka otu uru. Site na tebụl, kedu estimate na ihe kpatara dabara?

y-m-63-08.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri usoro tebụl chepụta ihe average velocity ga-abụ ma h belata ruo 0.001.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.o.a: Ihe dịka 9 m/s. Interval dị mkpụmkpụ, average velocity na-abịaru 9.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.r.a: Mkpebi a gụrụ na average velocity na-abịaru otu uru ka interval na-ebelata.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.o.b: 11 m/s. Average nke interval kachasị ogologo bụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.r.b: Echiche a chere average ogologo oge ka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi. Cheta velocity na-agbanwe n’ime interval.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.o.c: 9.02 m/s. Uru ikpeazụ tebụl bụ velocity na sekọnd 2.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.r.c: Echiche a were uru ngụkọta kwụsịrị dịka azịza. Chepụta uru ma interval belata karịa.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ịmata. N’otu instant oge anaghị agafe, velocity anaghị edozi.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.r.d: Echiche a kwụsịrị n’ebe enweghị ike ikekọrịta mgbe oge bụ 0. Ọ hapụrụ usoro ile uru average na-abịaru ka interval belata.
y-m-63-08.s.s1.explain: Ka h belata 1,0.5,0.1,0.01, average velocity 11,10,9.2,9.02 na-abịaru 9. N’ezie average bụ 9+2h, ya mere ka h na-abịaru 0, ọ na-abịaru 9; anyị kọwaa uru ahụ dịka instantaneous velocity na sekọnd 2. (0.01 0.1 0.5 1 10 11)
